guide_sources.name: The GTA 6 Guide — Trophy List (28 Hidden)
GamesRadar — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement list

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 are done. There is no separate task for it, so the roadmap is the guide: finish the story, clear the side stories, then work the 100% checklist and the cleanup list. Around 200 hours in total.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, can't be missed. It pops at the end of Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1. Just play the mission through.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, can't be missed. It pops when Chapter 1 ends and Chapter 2 starts, with the mission What's in the Bag? Keep playing the story.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, can't be missed. It pops when Chapter 2 ends and Chapter 3 opens with Welcome to Vice City.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, can't be missed. It pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, can't be missed. It pops after the last main mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, can't be missed. It pops when you finish the final mission of the story. No extra requirements.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, can't be missed. It pops during Chapter 2 when you finish the mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, can't be missed. It pops during Chapter 3 when you finish The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, can't be missed. It pops during Chapter 4 when you finish Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, can't be missed. It pops during Chapter 4 when you finish Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, can't be missed. It pops during Chapter 4 when you finish the VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, can't be missed. It pops when you finish Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. The checklist unlocks after the story under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, and progress you made during the story already counts. It is far more forgiving than it sounds, closer to 60% true completion: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts. Nothing on the list is missable, and it is all still doable in free-roam after the story.
steps: Finish the story first. The checklist only appears afterwards, under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion.
Work through the checklist in free-roam: 100 optional missions, 200 vehicles scanned, 100 animals studied, 70 challenges, 300 stunts.
Do optional missions as they appear during the story. There are 200 to 300 of them, far more than the 100 needed.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts. The four types are 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps, and you can mix them. Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest. Track progress by region under Progress, Activities, Stunts, or on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so this pops on the way.
steps: Pick the quickest type first: flying under bridges, 202 of them.
Mix in stunt jumps (130) and knife flights (40) when they are on your route.
Track by region under Progress, Activities, Stunts.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race or drone race, and performing a stunt. Check what you have done under Touchpad, Progress, Activities. Most of them happen on their own while you work on the other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges, spread across 12 range locations. A silver or bronze anywhere leaves it locked. Ranges are also how you raise the Focus stat, which helps with Gunslinger later.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. There are 42 drone races in total, but one win per location is enough. Repeats at the same spot add nothing.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 unique race locations. Winning the same race twice does not raise the count, so keep moving to new spots.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing spot marked with a purple icon. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in a challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game all the way through. There are four video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind on the TV at home, and Bang For Your Buck on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one, not beat every challenge in it.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline, Lucia only. In Chapter 3 you get a call from Andy, then a text with her address in Belville. Finish her five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. Everything stays available after the story.
steps: Wait for Andy's call in Chapter 3 (Lucia), then follow her text to Belville.
Climbing the Cellerichain, parts 1 to 3.
Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, then Puff Puff Pass.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline. It starts in Chapter 1 after the mission Island Dreams, when he calls and gets marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks. Use the metal detector on the ocean floor and bring each find back. He goes quiet for a while after Chapter 1 and comes back in Chapters 2-3, so don't worry if he disappears.
steps: After Island Dreams in Chapter 1, answer Kenton's call and find the green KR icon in Key Lento.
Dive each shipwreck he marks, dig up the treasure with the metal detector, bring it back.
Clear all 7 shipwrecks. Track it under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline. It opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Finish his five jobs: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All still available after the story.
steps: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, head to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, then Hometown Heroes.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands. Only certain strands count: Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this one. A strand only counts when it is finished, and you can track the count in the trophy list. Everything is still there in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's wishlist. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City (green RK icon). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is on the list, then drive it back in good condition for a better payout. Track it under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List.
steps: Finish Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3 and deliver the Zorrusso.
Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to see if Randy wants them.
Drive each wanted car back to his garage in west Vice City, in good condition.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline, Jason only. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers show Synthetic Labs around Vice City. Destroy them in the Take Out Kitty Litter quest, then Tyrone gives you Spin On This to shut the labs down. All available after the story.
steps: After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3 (Jason), follow the purple Synthetic Lab markers.
Destroy the labs in Take Out Kitty Litter.
Finish Tyrone's second quest, Spin On This.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at the same spot counts twice, and you can track it under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. THE ONE MISSABLE TROPHY IN THE GAME: during Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning. She says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony. Follow her, accept, and she teaches you. That meditation is gone for good after Chapter 1, and it is still unclear whether it is required for the trophy, so do it while you can. You also can't finish the last meditation until both characters can play together, after Chapter 2's Coffee Break.
steps: Chapter 1, after Down to Earth: in the morning, talk to Lucia in the kitchen.
Follow her to the balcony when she says she is going to meditate, and choose Accept.
Meditate at the other 18 spots, with both characters where you can, and track it under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting questline, Jason only. After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Bret texts you about the first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. He gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle and marks hunting spots with purple icons. Hunt the animals he asks for and bring them back. You need all 15 Target Decks for the 100% checklist, so this comes along the way.
steps: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2 (Jason), answer Bret's text and meet him in Lummox County.
Take the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle and follow the purple hunting markers.
Hunt each animal he asks for and bring it back to Bret.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card set locations in total. Loose cards spread across many sets don't count, you need three sets finished.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the phone app (hold up, then R1). There are more than 100 in the world: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher tags. Any 100 count.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist wants 70 of 80, so this pops on the way there. Track them under Progress, Challenges. Many finish on their own while you work on other trophies, so leave this for late and pick the easiest ones left.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you. You can only do this after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when both characters can roam together. Call your partner with hold-right plus triangle. Cause chaos until you hit 4 stars, then drive out of the red heat zone. A fast bike through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia works well because the helicopter loses you there. It also pops on its own during the Chapter 4 bank-vault mission, so don't force it early.
steps: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, call your partner (hold right, then triangle).
Build a 4-star wanted level, then drive out of the red heat zone.
A fast motorcycle through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia is the easiest escape.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Keep the flashing wanted level alive between shops. If it drops, the chain breaks. Gear up first: armor vest, sticky bombs and healing from Ammu-Nation. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City work well once they open after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. The trophy pops about half a minute after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment.
steps: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, call your partner and stock up at Ammu-Nation.
Rob 3 shops in a row, keeping the wanted level alive between them.
Wait about half a minute after leaving the third shop for it to pop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The fastest way is the WAiNK app: stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. Scanning is enough, you don't need to drive them. There are 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist wants 200 scanned, so this pops on the way. Check totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3+R3 while aiming. It slows time and drains the purple focus bar. Buff focus first with food, drinks, or a wash and shower at home, and use Adrenaline to stretch the time. Line up five enemies at a gang operation and drop them fast with an assault rifle like the Duke 556. It doesn't count on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots.
steps: Buff focus with food and drinks, or a wash and shower at home. Adrenaline stretches Combat Focus.
Find five enemies together at a gang operation and wear body armor.
Aim, hit L3+R3, and drop all five before the focus bar runs out.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA, Vice City International Airport. Planes sitting on the airfield don't count. It has to be one connected to a boarding bridge. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, take the stairs by the bridge, go upstairs into the cockpit, reverse onto the airstrip and take off. Fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops.
steps: Drive through a fence onto the VCIA airfield and head for the plane at terminals E3/E4.
Take the stairs by the boarding bridge, go upstairs and enter the cockpit.
Reverse onto the airstrip, take off, and fly about 1 km away from the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. The Rhinos stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and shoot until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun for silent lockpicking and marks the stores. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot. It pops shortly after you leave.
steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to unlock the Snap Gun.
Enter a jewelry store through the back door with the Snap Gun, not the front.
Find the safe code note, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Start with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe): tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open and grab the cash, handing a bag to your partner with hold-right. After that, Yasmani sells security-van tips for $10,000 (finish his two Payday Loans jobs first). There are 8 large bank jobs and the 100% checklist wants all of them, so this pops on the way. Each vault pays up to $205,000.
steps: Finish the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… to learn bank vault robberies.
Buy security-van tips from Yasmani for $10,000, then tail a van to its bank.
Slip in while the vault is open, grab the cash, hand a bag to your partner, and escape on a fast bike.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically in the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…, since robbing the bank vault there counts. You can also do it earlier: block an armored truck near a bank, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it, then get out of the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: fully unfog the map across all 52 areas. The fastest way is by plane, flying over every black-fogged patch until the whole map is visible.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Only one per gang counts, so robbing several from the same gang adds nothing. Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many get marked from story progress. Track each gang under Progress, Gangs. There are 39 in total and the 100% checklist wants all of them.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini and drink it standing next to the bar. That's the whole trophy.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. It only pops with this specific blue Banshee, a nod to the Banshee from GTA III, and it triggers a moment after you get out onto the street.
steps: Unlock the Key Cloner in Chapter 3 (Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS).
Go to the showroom in south Vice City and hack into the blue Banshee.
Drive forward straight through the showroom window.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the safe in the north-east hallway, which needs sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation. It pops after you escape the police, not when you pick the third item. The spot opens during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, and if you miss an item the robbery icon respawns later, so it isn't missable.
steps: Buy sticky bombs at Ammu-Nation first, you need them for the safe.
At Kingpin Bowling, take the luxury watch (south-east office) and the Gutterball shotgun (north-east table).
Blow the safe in the north-east hallway, then escape the police.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, Strength (heart icon). You can only work on this after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch between characters. Buy a fitness club membership and always bring your partner along. While one works out, the other finishes training too. Filter fitness clubs on Map, Activities.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on notifications under Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile, and a demon face shows whenever an action counts. Robberies, clean escapes, stealth finishes, incapacitations and kills all add up, and the game tracks the count when you click the trophy in the trophy list. It mostly happens on its own. If it is the last one left it can be farmed, but that pushes your profile toward Psycho or the permanent Irredeemable status, which makes cops shoot on sight.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. The community's best guess ties it to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, but nobody has pinned down the exact trigger yet. Don't chase it. It will likely pop on its own while you do robberies, and this guide will be updated once someone confirms it.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (currently unknown)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Finish the UFO easter egg. Go alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County at night, after 2AM. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside. If it isn't there, drive away and come back. Follow the path into the woods next to it and you'll see the UFO. Approach it, it drops an abducted woman, talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside.
steps: Go alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM.
Look for the blinking car at the roadside. If it isn't there, drive away and come back.
Follow the path into the woods to the UFO, approach it, talk to the woman it drops, and walk her back to her car.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. The best guess is kicking people over while driving a motorcycle, a melee drive-by, but the exact trigger is still unproven. Try it in passing while you ride around. This guide will be updated once someone confirms it.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (currently unknown)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence. Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total is cumulative across robberies. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in one hit, so it comes naturally with the robbery cleanup.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total runs across every shop type, so guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way there since they cost the most. It counts while you buy gear for the other trophies anyway.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages. They cost $160,000 in total. Garages open for purchase after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. A Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone and you buy through it. The 4 story garages don't count. Robberies in Chapters 3-4 are the quickest way to the cash.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app lands on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register. You need enough garage spots first, so buy garages before chasing this one. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Cheap cars and bikes keep the cost down.
steps: Buy garages first (Little Boxes). Each one adds parking spots for registrations.
After the Chapter 2 mission Moses, drive a stolen car or bike to Moses in Port Gellhorn.
Choose Respray, then Register. Repeat for 10 vehicles.
